decisions.reason: The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the established machine offer at low carrying cost, so keeping this option open is cheap and it supports sales of the core systems.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and its value is still highly uncertain, but it holds strategic upside in the firm's future-oriented materials processing, so the option is kept open for now while it is watched closely.

The high-speed CNC milling line is close to the core business, has its own page and several models, and has effectively become a further commitment in the established offer, so dropping it is unlikely.
The automatic tool change system complements the milling machines and modular engineering, so it costs little to maintain and adds value to the core line.
